title: The Smallest Winter Lesson
alt: A giant-eared spectacled creature and a small bespectacled boy study a frost-covered leaf beside a quiet alpine lake.
description: A giant-eared spectacled creature and a small bespectacled boy study a frost-covered leaf beside a quiet alpine lake.

title: A Waltz for the Windmill
alt: A crested bird plays its long instrument while a capped bird dances through a lavender dusk courtyard beneath a crooked windmill.
description: A crested bird plays its long instrument while a capped bird dances through a lavender dusk courtyard beneath a crooked windmill.

title: The First Small Miracle
alt: A curled bearded wizard demonstrates a hovering stone to an angular insect robot above a valley of floating root islands.
description: A curled bearded wizard demonstrates a hovering stone to an angular insect robot above a valley of floating root islands.

title: Room for a Crown
alt: A toothy rabbit angles its fringed umbrella over a surprised three-eyed king on the rain-soaked approach to an ornate manor.
description: A toothy rabbit angles its fringed umbrella over a surprised three-eyed king on the rain-soaked approach to an ornate manor.

title: One Foot on the River
alt: An antler-crowned paddler steadies a curved canoe while a leaf-horned faun steps aboard from a root-bound bank in a green pine valley.
description: An antler-crowned paddler steadies a curved canoe while a leaf-horned faun steps aboard from a root-bound bank in a green pine valley.

title: The Leaf Gambit
alt: A shaggy figure beneath a leafy top hat considers an antenna gentleman’s move in a game of leaves played on a fallen log.
description: A shaggy figure beneath a leafy top hat considers an antenna gentleman’s move in a game of leaves played on a fallen log.

title: The First Roll of Winter
alt: A tall-capped little chef offers a warm bread roll to a spiral-eyed owl outside a tiny bakery as the first snow falls.
description: A tall-capped little chef offers a warm bread roll to a spiral-eyed owl outside a tiny bakery as the first snow falls.

title: Shelter in the Downpour
alt: A wooden robot bends its enormous hat leaf to shelter a coat-wearing teardrop visitor as rain sweeps past an old windmill.

title: A Conversation Across the Water

title: The Antler Clearing
alt: An antlered deer lowers its head to a shaggy owl in a quiet snowy clearing, touching the offered tip of a wing.
description: An antlered deer lowers its head to a shaggy owl in a quiet snowy clearing, touching the offered tip of a wing.

title: The Little Boardwalk
alt: A grinning crab steadies a fallen log while a thoughtful beaver rolls its skateboard over a narrow coastal runnel.
description: A grinning crab steadies a fallen log while a thoughtful beaver rolls its skateboard over a narrow coastal runnel.

title: A Very Small Voyage

description: A dragon in oversized boots guides a shallow pan carrying a bespectacled long-eared dog across a sunlit woodland puddle.

title: The Courtyard Introduction

title: Directions by Trumpet

title: Tea Above the Treetops
